overseer-judge task [flags] <path|->

lint an overseer task file for spec defects

Output: the lint report as one JSON object: file, static, judgments, model, usage.

Flags:
  -dry-run
    	print the request that would be sent and exit 0
  -log-level string
    	stderr diagnostics: debug, info, warn, error (default "warn")
  -model string
    	Jev model (default from TYPESAFE_DEFAULT_MODEL)
  -pretty
    	indent JSON output
  -timeout duration
    	timeout for each HTTP attempt (default 10s)

Example:
  overseer-judge task --pretty .overseer/tasks/003-tasklint.md
